name: cloudcodex-environment-discovery
description: Read-only independent Codex Legacy and Current discovery. Optional structured Root advisory to cloudrepo-environment-direct; no direct CI execution. Current live catalog/detail await supported access.

interface.longDescription: Read-only discovery of existing Codex Cloud environments. Legacy discovery operational. Current catalog and exact Configuration-ID GET implemented, but Current live reads remain on hold awaiting supported authorized API access (401 JSON/403 challenge observed). Optional structured Root advisory may recommend cloudrepo-environment-direct for software validation after bounded observation; it never executes CI. Independent skills, optional MCP, no provisioning or credential extraction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Determine the requested Codex Cloud type first. For Legacy invoke $legacy-discovery; for current-generation Cloud invoke $current-discovery. If both are explicitly requested, invoke the two skills separately and report separate provider statuses; do not produce an implicit mixed catalog. Read-only: no task or environment creation. For software validation only, unresolved executor evidence may produce the optional structured recommendation cloudrepo-environment-direct; Root alone preflights and authorizes direct CI. On Current 401/403 report the actual denial and mark live Current discovery pending; never infer an empty catalog or switch identities.
